flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminprivateapi agencies/lta/download/helpers/{LtaProcessingOrchestrator,LtaDownloadHelper,LtaBatchCode0Processor}, autorevival/{jobs/AutoRevivalJob,helpers/AutoRevivalHelper}, agencies/toppan/upload/{models/ToppanStage,helpers/ToppanUploadHelper,jobs/ToppanUploadJob}, schedulers/ToppanUploadJobsScheduler, notification_sms_email/helpers/NotificationSmsEmailHelper, OcmsValidOffenceNoticeRepository, cron-schedules-prod.properties, application-prod.properties. ocmsadminapi notice_creation/core/helpers/SuspensionBaseHelper (CLV only at RR3/DR3 rule). ocmsadminui, ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi: no code for these steps
note: Status 'Requirement given - Gen flow'. The processing chain for type V notices is in ocmsadminprivateapi: the LTA result moves a V notice straight to RD1 (LtaProcessingOrchestrator.java:119-127), the daily Auto Revival revives suspensions that are due and skips notices that are already paid (AutoRevivalJob.java:103-163, AutoRevivalHelper.java:828), and then the RD1, RD2, RR3 reminders are produced by the Toppan upload. Two big problems on the reminders: letter generation by the day-end scheduler is commented out (ToppanUploadJobsScheduler.java:118) so it only runs through the manual trigger POST /toppan/generate-letters, and sftp.upload.disabledServers=toppan in application-prod.properties:86 blocks the upload to Toppan; the delivery gate is bypassed and the stage still advances without delivery (OCMS-DF-2026-192, status Ready to UAT). SMS/email are not sent for type V (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:1061, 1151), so reminders are letters only. After RR3, TS-CLV is applied and keeps looping while the notice is unpaid (AutoRevivalHelper.java:798-851, 1041-1146), so the notice stops at RR3 and never advances to DN1/court; follow-up after the TS ends is in practice manual by the OIC. The initial TS-CLV at the Toppan upload uses a vehicle number starting with V (ToppanUploadHelper.java:706), while the looping uses type V (AutoRevivalHelper.java:1111): two different criteria. The repo does not define a 'pre-court processing stage'; I read it as stopping after the third reminder, which URA must confirm. The gap between stages is read from the stage map in the database (ToppanUploadHelper.java:1366-1370); the ToppanStage enum is only a 14-day default and the real value cannot be verified from the repo. Tickets: OCMS-DF-2026-052 (the VIP path to RD1 is not affected by the Diplomat bug), OCMS-DF-2026-032 (fix for saving revival data when TS-CLV is re-applied, deployed), OCMS-DF-2026-192 (open).
recommendation: Claim partially: the V-to-RD1 path, the daily revival and the hold at RR3 through TS-CLV exist. Do not claim 'reminders sent' while letter generation is manual only and the Toppan upload is blocked in the prod properties. Ask URA to confirm the meaning of 'pre-court processing stage' and whether V notices should indeed stop at RR3 with a TS-CLV loop.

steps.step: The LTA result moves a classified vehicle (type V) notice to the RD1 reminder stage
steps.detail: LtaDownloadHelper calls processVipVehicle when vehicle_registration_type = 'V' (LtaDownloadHelper.java:428, batch path LtaBatchCode0Processor.java:161-163); processVipVehicle fills the owner data and then updateProcessingStageToRD1 (LtaProcessingOrchestrator.java:119-127), without going through ENA. Ticket OCMS-DF-2026-052 states the VIP path is not hit by the Diplomat cache bug. The LTA download cron is enabled=true in prod (cron-schedules-prod.properties:148-149); the LTA result file from SFTP cannot be verified from the repo.

steps.step: After the temporary suspension ends, outstanding notices are revived every day
steps.detail: AutoRevivalJob fetches suspensions that are due (queryNoticesForRevival, line 103) and revives them (line 135); processClvPostRevival skips notices that are already paid via isPaidNotice (AutoRevivalHelper.java:828-831) and the looping skips payment_status FP (line 1112). This job runs as job 2 of the Toppan Upload day-end at 00:15 (ToppanUploadJobsScheduler.java:119, cron-schedules-prod.properties:61-62 enabled=true). Ticket OCMS-DF-2026-032 (fix for revival data not saved when TS is re-applied) is deployed. The cron value on the server cannot be verified from the repo.

steps.step: The notice advances through 3 reminders (RD1, RD2, RR3) in order
steps.detail: The RD1, RD2, RR3 stage chain with a 14-day default exists (ToppanStage.java:19-21), and the stage query picks notices whose suspension_type is empty and whose next_processing_date is due (OcmsValidOffenceNoticeRepository.java:608-614); after the letter is produced, the next stage and next date are written (ToppanUploadHelper.java:1366-1370, values from the stage map in the database). But the call toppanLettersGeneratorService.executeJob() in the day-end scheduler is commented out (ToppanUploadJobsScheduler.java:118), so letter generation only runs through the manual trigger POST /toppan/generate-letters, not automatically every day. The real durations in the database cannot be verified from the repo.

steps.step: Reminders are sent to the vehicle owner to inform them of the outstanding parking offence
steps.detail: sftp.upload.disabledServers=toppan in application-prod.properties:86 blocks the upload to Toppan; ToppanUploadJob bypasses the delivery gate and the stage still advances without delivery (ToppanUploadJob.java:419-426, ticket OCMS-DF-2026-192 still open). SMS and email are excluded for types I, D, V (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:1061, 1151), so the only channel is the letter. The real server property value and receipt by the owner cannot be verified from the repo.

steps.step: After the 3rd reminder the notice stops at the pre-court stage and is not processed further
steps.detail: After RR3/DR3 is uploaded, applyClvSuspensionForVipVehicles applies TS-CLV (ToppanUploadHelper.java:332-334, 691-706) and AutoRevivalJob keeps looping TS-CLV for type V notices at RR3/DR3 that are not FP (ARJ:178, AutoRevivalHelper.java:1041-1112) and re-applies it right after revival (lines 834-838); TS-CLV is only allowed at RR3/DR3 (ocmsadminapi SuspensionBaseHelper.java:72-73). The stage query excludes suspended notices (OcmsValidOffenceNoticeRepository.java:610), so the notice does not advance to DN1/court. Gap: the initial criterion uses a vehicle number starting with V (ToppanUploadHelper.java:706) while the looping uses type V (line 1111); and because the TS is always re-applied, there is no automatic follow-up after the TS ends. The repo does not define a 'pre-court processing stage', so whether RR3 matches that term must be confirmed by URA.
